detail.longDescription: RE: https:// mastodon.art/@707Kat/117541171 780826103 I don't think I posted this here, but due to the Microsoft outage this friday I found out another stupid detail about the whole Github agent issue. Turns out that Microsoft cut a deal with AWS in June in order to limit outages and Github still went down in mid August. That's also most likely why Github wasn't one of the Microsoft services that went offline this Friday. # Microslop # github https://www. neowin.net/news/report-microso ft-to-use-aws-to-help-github-deal-with-a-major-surge-in-demand/
